name: Bambu Lab
description: Bambu Lab printer driver via bambulabs_api with AMS and all-spool gallery views, optional catalog images, RFID spool discovery, estimated-weight synchronization and automatic filament matching. Note: Sending filament settings (spool assignment) requires LAN-only mode AND Developer Mode enabled on the printer. Read-only mode never sends state-changing MQTT commands.
author: FilaMan

printer_model.title: Printer Model
printer_model.description: Select your Bambu Lab printer model. Determines AMS data structure handling.

host.title: IP/Hostname
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Bambu printer

read_only.title: Read-only Mode
read_only.description: Read printer and AMS status, but never send state-changing commands to the printer

auto_import_spools.title: Automatically Import Bambu RFID Spools
auto_import_spools.description: Create unknown Bambu RFID spools from existing filaments

sync_spool_weight.title: Synchronize Estimated Spool Weight
sync_spool_weight.description: Set and update remaining spool weight from Bambu Lab's tray weight and remaining-percentage estimates during automatic spool import

resolve_shop_images.title: Catalog Images (Bambu Lab)
resolve_shop_images.description: Resolve color-specific images through Bambu Lab's EU Store Search API, with a product-page fallback, and store only their URLs on the matching FilaMan filament. Browsers load enabled images directly from Bambu Lab's CDN; no image files are stored locally.

reconnect_interval_minutes.title: Reconnect Interval (Minutes)
reconnect_interval_minutes.description: Interval in minutes between reconnection attempts on connection loss
